description: This file defines the TalkOverlayController class responsible for managing the presentation, dismissal, and state updates of a talk overlay UI component in a macOS application. It includes methods for handling window display, updating overlay states like phase and level, and integrating with overlay factory utilities.

classes.name: TalkOverlayController
classes.description: Main controller class managing the talk overlay UI component, including presentation logic, state management, and interaction with the overlay window.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Displays the overlay window, creates it if necessary, and sets up its view.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the overlay window with animation and updates visibility state.

methods.name: updatePhase
methods.description: Updates the current phase of the talk overlay and logs the change.

methods.name: updatePaused
methods.description: Updates the paused state of the overlay and logs the change.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Adjusts the overlay's level indicator within [0,1] and only if visible.

methods.name: currentWindowOrigin
methods.description: Returns the current origin point of the overlay window.

methods.name: setWindowOrigin
methods.description: Sets the origin point of the overlay window.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Creates the overlay window if it doesn't exist, and sets up its content view.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Calculates and returns the frame for positioning the overlay on the main screen.
